environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed in an isolated private subnet (subnet-0f8e7d6c5b4a3) within VPC vpc-0a9b8c7d6e. The subnet's route table (rtb-0x1y2z3w4v) contains only local routes (10.0.48.0/20 -> local) and a com.amazonaws.us-east-1.sqs VPC endpoint route entry (vpce-0abc123def456). There is NO route to a NAT Gateway, Internet Gateway, or any Transit Gateway attachment. The VPC has no peering connections. Outbound security group (sg-0deadbeef1234) allows TCP 443 to prefix list pl-63a5400a (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.sqs VPC endpoint). Network ACL (acl-0f1e2d3c4b) on the subnet has explicit DENY for all traffic to 0.0.0.0/0 except the VPC CIDR 10.0.0.0/16. IMDSv2 is enforced on the task (HttpTokens=required, hop-limit=1). The task execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/FargateTaskBoundary) that denies sts:AssumeRole and any action outside sqs:*.

config.security_group_outbound: sg-0deadbeef1234: TCP/443 -> pl-63a5400a (SQS VPC endpoint only)
